name: mindbody-attendance-trends
description: Find regulars whose attendance is slipping, from Mindbody report exports, on your own computer.
long_description: Reads the Attendance without Revenue export (CSV or Excel) and, optionally, Autopay Detail (on hold) and Membership exports. Finds regulars whose last 3 weeks fell well below their usual. Claude sees member codes and counts; names appear only in a report page that opens in your browser. Unofficial; not affiliated with Mindbody.

tools.name: load_exports
tools.description: Read Mindbody exports on this computer; returns counts only.

tools.name: map_columns
tools.description: Choose which header holds each field when detection is unsure.

tools.name: slipping_regulars
tools.description: Regulars whose last 3 weeks fell to 60% of usual or less, as member codes.

tools.name: open_report
tools.description: Open a local report page with names in the default browser.

share_names_with_claude.title: Share member names with Claude
share_names_with_claude.description: Off: Claude sees member codes like M-0147 and numbers, and names appear only in the browser report. On: Claude also sees names, which are then sent to Anthropic as part of the chat.
